agent_explanation: Two heavy bodies undergo a deep close encounter: separation falls from 0.92 (step7) to 0.52 (step8) to 0.15 (step9), i.e. below softening 0.3, while speeds rise to ~12. With large outer dt~0.033 the substep controller (16->19->25 substeps) increases but insufficiently, so leapfrog integration error accumulates and total energy drops from -82.6 to -125.75, exceeding the 2% tolerance. Reducing only dt removes the violation, confirming timestep-resolution cause.
